title: koeleria phleoides f. maritima
intro: Koeleria phleoides f. maritima, commonly known as coastal koeleria, is a subspecies of the Koeleria phleoides plant, a type of grass found in coastal areas. The coastal koeleria has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties, which aid in treating various health issues such as wounds, skin infections, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of the coastal koeleria include its ability to soothe and calm irritated tissues, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the coastal koeleria include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
